doc: Hand-derived from ct.gd, not measured (README.md). Regions are inclusive [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the 64x64 cells. `drawn`: images reached only through an ok canvas texture's diffuse, which both receivers must draw as the reference does. `refused`: canvas textures with a normal or specular map are unsupported (canvas-texture-channel, render-stream-2.md 'Texture'): the receivers skip their commands, so those cells stay the clear colour. SWAP's canvas texture gets a new diffuse at step 1; UPD's diffuse is updated in place at step 1. POLY's diffuse is created after its canvas texture (a higher wire id).
